Answer: C
Reason: The frontal chest X-ray (Figure 1a) explicitly highlights two distinct nodules with blue arrows: one in the right middle lobe region silhouetting the right heart border and another retrocardiac nodule on the left. This specific finding of discrete nodules, often associated with a mosaic attenuation pattern on CT (though not visible here, it is part of the classic presentation), is characteristic of Diffuse Idiopathic Pulmonary Neuroendocrine Cell Hyperplasia (DIPNECH). Options A, B, D, E, and F describe patterns (single large nodule, diffuse small nodules, effusions, perihilar infiltrates, cavitary lesions) that do not match the two focal lesions indicated by the arrows.
